name: portable-review
description: Portable file walk-in: recon -> two-way fan-out review -> three-line summary. run_context seeds (ALL required): 'target_dir' = the absolute path to an existing directory containing at least two readable files. Recon lists its two most important files; review reads each for a one-paragraph finding. No code or secrets travel with the graph. Nodes start in their own work directories, so the target must be supplied explicitly.

nodes.goal: List the two most important files in {run.target_dir} (use a file listing; do not invent names). Reply with exactly this JSON shape and nothing else: {"files": ["<path>", "<path>"]}

fanout.goal: Review {item} in one paragraph: what it does and one concrete risk. Reply exactly: {"file": "{item}", "finding": "<one paragraph>"}

nodes.goal: Merge the review findings into a three-line summary. Reply exactly: {"summary": "<three lines>"}
